channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: U.S. and Iran Exchange Fire Amid a Declared Truce
item.description: Iran will respond to a US peace proposal through Pakistan. An Iranian official said that Tehran would convey its reply through Pakistan, a key mediator. Another Iranian official had earlier dismissed a reported proposal to end the war as a “list of American wishes.”.

item.title: U.S. and Iran Trade Fire in Strait of Hormuz, Despite Cease-Fire
item.description: The US and Iran traded fire in the Strait of Hormuz despite a cease-fire. Iran War Live Updates: U. S. and Iran Trade Fire in Strait of Hormuz, Despite Cease-Fire The New York Times.

item.description: The US awaits Iran's response to the latest peace-talks proposal. Iran War News Live Updates: U. S. Awaits Iran’s Response to Latest Peace-Talks Proposal WSJ. U. U. S.

item.title: U.S. trade court rules against Trump's global 10% tariff
item.description: A US trade court ruled against Trump's 10% global tariff in a 2-1 decision. The 2-1 ruling by the U. S. Court of International Trade, for now, blocks the tariffs from being implemented against just two companies and the state of Washington.

item.title: U.S. military says it intercepted Iranian attacks on 3 Navy ships in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The US military intercepted Iranian attacks on 3 Navy ships in the Strait of Hormuz. The U. S. military also says that it "targeted Iranian military facilities responsible for attacking U. S.

item.title: Oil prices jump on renewed US-Iran hostilities
item.description: Oil prices jumped due to renewed US-Iran hostilities in the Strait of Hormuz. Oil prices jump on renewed US-Iran hostilities.

item.title: In Hungary, Voters Exposed the Limits of China’s Ties to Orban
item.description: Hungarian voters limited China's ties to Europe by rejecting a giant battery factory. Beijing depended on Hungary’s outgoing leader, Viktor Orban, to gain a toehold in Europe. A giant battery factory proved a step too far.

item.title: US and Iran close to temporary truce, Pakistani officials claim
item.description: Pakistani officials claim the US and Iran are close to a temporary truce. The details of the agreement are not specified, but it is said to be a tentative arrangement.

item.title: Nvidia to invest up to $2.1 billion in IREN as part of AI data center deal
item.description: Nvidia will invest up to $2.1 billion in IREN as part of an AI data center deal. Nvidia to invest up to $2.1 billion in IREN as part of AI data center deal.

item.title: US Military Strikes Iran's Qeshm Port, Bandar Abbas: Report
item.description: The US military struck Iran's Qeshm port and Bandar Abbas, a senior US official said. The US military on Thursday carried out strikes on Iran's Qeshm port and Bandar Abbas, a Fox News reporter said in a post on X, citing a senior US official.

item.title: US military says it carries out retaliatory strikes against Iran
item.description: Iranian media claims US warships were damaged and forced to retreat after a US attack on an Iranian oil tanker. Iranian media claimed US warships were damaged and forced to retreat after the attack.

item.title: U.S. and Iran trade fire in Strait of Hormuz; each claims other shot first
item.description: The US and Iran traded fire in the Strait of Hormuz, each claiming the other shot first. U. S. and Iran trade fire in Strait of Hormuz; each claims other shot first CNBC.

item.title: US Trade Court Rules Against Trump's 10% Global Tariffs
item.description: A US trade court ruled against Donald Trump's 10% global tariffs on Thursday. The US trade court on Thursday ruled against President Donald Trump's latest 10% global tariffs. US Trade Court Rules Against Trump's 10% Global Tariffs.

item.title: US trade court rules against Trump’s 10 percent global tariffs
item.description: A US trade court ruled against Trump's 10% global tariffs, siding with small businesses. The court ruled in favour of small businesses that challenged the tariffs that took place in February.

item.title: International Olympic Committee lifts restrictions on Belarusian athletes
item.description: The International Olympic Committee lifted restrictions on Belarusian athletes, allowing them to compete under their own flag and anthem, including in team sports, and participate in all qualifying events for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics starting later this year.

item.title: Tenerife resort town awaits hantavirus-hit cruise ship
item.description: A cruise ship affected by a hantavirus outbreak is set to dock in southern Tenerife, prompting local reactions. The ship's arrival has raised concerns among locals. Locals react to cruise ship affected by a hantavirus outbreak which is set to dock in southern Tenerife.

item.title: Iran says it attacked US Navy ships after they targeted Iranian tanker
item.description: Iran attacked US Navy ships after they targeted an Iranian tanker. The US military responded to the attack. US military says it intercepted and responded to 'unprovoked' Iranian attack, stressing that it doesn't seek escalation.

item.title: Five killed in huge fire at packed Mexico fairground
item.description: A huge fire at a packed Mexico fairground in Villahermosa killed five people during a concert attended by approximately 135,000 people. The blaze erupted in the south-eastern city. The blaze in the south-eastern city of Villahermosa erupted during a concert reportedly attended by some 135,000 people.

item.title: Trump sets July 4 deadline for EU tariff hike decision
item.description: Trump set a July 4 deadline for deciding on EU tariff hikes after a call with Ursula von der Leyen. Trump claimed he had a 'great call' European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen about the looming tariffs.

item.title: Trump gives 4 July ultimatum to EU to approve trade deal with US
item.description: US President Trump has given the European Union until July 4 to enact a trade deal agreed last year and drop tariffs on American goods to zero. The deal was agreed upon in 2021, but the EU has yet to meet its commitments.
